ModMetaData.name: The Slorg
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.18
We are the Slorg. Your biological and technological distinctiveness will be added to our own.
Adds the Slorg Collective, a cybernetic hive-mind enemy faction.
- Assimilation: drones inject your downed colonists with nanoprobes. The infection takes about 3 days, and only exceptional tends with glitterworld medicine can purge it. If it finishes, your colonist joins the Slorg. - Collective knowledge: each drone works at the collective's best level in every skill. Kill the drone that knew it and the collective loses it. - The queen: she comes with very large raids. Kill or capture her and the drones around her are severed, so you can capture them and cut them free with surgery. - The Unicomplex: destroy the queen core in their main settlement to end Slorg control of the planet. - Disconnected drones: freed Slorg keep their implants and can join you, but their genes can't be passed on.
Requires Biotech and Harmony.
